Q: Count the number of vowels in a text A:

Use String#count.

def count_vowels(phrase)
  phrase = phrase.downcase

  %w[a e i o u].to_h do |vowel|
    [vowel, phrase.count(vowel)]
  end
end

count_vowels "Every vowel matters"
# => {"a" => 1, "e" => 4, "i" => 0, "o" => 1, "u" => 0}

Note that in your attempt, you're mixing up your definition of phrase by first trying to pass in ARGV (which is an Array, not a String) and then inside your method overwriting phrase using $stdin.gets.

Whichever technique you choose to get the text from the user, do that outside the method and just pass in the string.

So, for example:

phrase = ARGV[0]
count_vowels(phrase)

or

# You don't need to chomp the newline;
# it's not a vowel and won't get counted anyway
phrase = $stdin.gets
count_vowels(phrase)

Q: New Outlook Design (2023) - ComObjActive("Outlook.Application") not working anymore A:

ComObjActive("Outlook.Application") does not work with the New Outlook for Windows because the new client does not support COM add-ins or the underlying COM object model.

  • The New Outlook is a distinct application that replaced the legacy COM infrastructure, causing errors like 0x800401E3 (Operation unavailable) when scripts attempt to access it via COM.

  • Microsoft explicitly states that COM add-ins are not supported in the New Outlook, which instead uses a sandboxed environment for Office web add-ins.

  • Users relying on AutoHotkey (AHK) or similar automation tools must either switch back to the classic Outlook for Windows (where COM continues to work) or explore alternative automation methods such as UI Automation or web-based APIs.

Q: Visual Studio 2022 stuck in Build A:

In my case, I imported an existing project to use it in another solution. The old project had a StyleCop reference in the (SDK) project file. It was something like

<ItemGroup>
  AdditionalFiles Include="$(SolutionDir)\stylecop.json" Link="$(SolutionDir)\stylecop.json"
</ItemGroup>

Since the new project does not have the stylecop.json file, it caused the build to hang. If this is the case for you either

  • Delete the <AdditionalFiles> line in the new project OR
  • Copy the stylecop.json file from the old location to the new location.
